checks.why: repr(v) runs type(v).__repr__: a test asserting a validator's repr covers what that __repr__ calls
len(x) runs __len__, and bool(x) on a class with no __bool__ runs __len__ too
str(x) on a class with no __str__ runs its __repr__
CONTROL: str(x) on a class that defines __str__ does not run its __repr__, and constructing it runs neither
